ratings_why.fun: Each Primrose Apprentice and Courier makes every later Phial better, so the board grows faster as the game goes on, and the lamp-or-spread choice is new every turn.
ratings_why.distinct: A shared Recipe that you write over the game and pour on any tribe's unit plays unlike today's tribes, though the T5 Burnet and Shipton are familiar anti-carry tools.

verdict_why: Stat lines that scale as a share of the target compound when several Phials land on one lamp in a turn, and the Treacle Painter may loop off its own Phials; both are real fixes.

points.text: A five-line Recipe of +1/+1 lines adds about 50% of the target per cast, so three Phials on one lamp grow it about x3.4 a turn, and Pavonia makes that about x11. Let a unit's share-scaling apply once a turn and later Phials that turn give the printed stats only.
Treacle Painter: a Phial is a one-use hand card, so it reads like an item. If it counts, each Phial makes another, a free loop. Say "(not a Phial)".
Mother Shipton does nothing with a keywords-only Recipe. She could give the biggest enemy Nightshade when the Recipe has no stat line, so the Dispensary build can run her too.
Old Carbonaria's +1/+1 per spell is small next to what one Phial gives a lamp by T5. Letting the bonus scale with the Recipe, or counting Phials double, would make her the lamp she wants to be.
Turns 1 to 4 rest on the Peddler's single Phial landing next to a Dusty Noctuid. A Noctuid that also gains from an ally's When played buff would help mono Moths hold the early fights.

standouts.why: A T2 card that sets the direction for the whole game: every Phial from now on is bigger.
A clean T4 multiplier: one Phial hits three slots and feeds the Drawn units behind them, a placement puzzle you'd want to solve.
A real capstone: the whole board gets the Recipe each fight, and his slot decides which Burnet lines fire.

weakest.why: A T5 stat holder that grows slower than the Phials it competes with.
Cheaper shop spells are economy any tribe could have, with little tie to the Recipe.
The tempo body only grows when a Phial lands beside it, which is rare early on.

flags.note: Several share-scaled Phials on one target in a turn compound exponentially, and Pavonia or the Warden plus Drawn multiply it further.
Two casts per Phial (three when golden) doubles the Nurse, the Grinder and Carbonaria's count as well as the stats.
Can't tell whether casting a Phial counts as using an item; if it does, the Painter loops.
